name: typed-product
cmd: set -euo pipefail; ROOT=$PWD; OUT=$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR; trap 'rm -rf "$OUT/project/.lake"' EXIT; bun install --frozen-lockfile > "$OUT/install.log" 2>&1; bun scripts/gen-lean-library.ts > "$OUT/library.log" 2>&1; bunx tsc -p lean-kernel/lift-typed/tsconfig.json > "$OUT/types.log" 2>&1 || touch "$OUT/types.failed"; bun test lean-kernel/lift-typed/roles.test.ts > "$OUT/unit.log" 2>&1; bun lean-kernel/lift-typed/remote-test.ts > "$OUT/emission.log" 2>&1; cd "$OUT/project"; lake build > "$OUT/lean.log" 2>&1; lake env lean BapaProof.lean > "$OUT/audit.log" 2>&1; lake env lean TypedControls.lean >> "$OUT/audit.log" 2>&1; cd "$ROOT"; bun lean-kernel/lift-typed/audit-test.ts > "$OUT/audit-result.log" 2>&1; test ! -f "$OUT/types.failed"
